repos.description: Predicting district level crop yield from rainfall and soil data
repos.readme:
# Crop yield prediction

Mini project for our data science elective. I used rainfall, soil
and area data for 12 districts and trained a random forest to predict
yield per hectare.

The messy part was data cleaning: three sources used different district
spellings and two years of rainfall data were missing. I documented every
transformation in notebooks/01-eda.ipynb.

Feature engineering: rolling rainfall averages, monsoon onset week, and a
soil category encoding. Feature importance and basic statistics are at the
end of the second notebook.

Best validation R2 was 0.71 with 5 fold cross validation.

repos.description: Content based movie recommender served over a small Flask API
repos.readme:
# Movie recommender

TF-IDF over movie overviews and cosine similarity for the nearest
neighbours. Flask serves two routes: a search page and a JSON REST API
endpoint that the page calls with fetch.

Run locally with: flask --app app run

Dataset is the TMDB 5000 movies CSV from Kaggle.

repos.description: Sentiment classification on an airline tweets dataset
repos.readme:
# Tweet sentiment analysis

NLP practice project. Cleaning steps: lowercase, strip handles and URLs,
remove stopwords with NLTK, then TF-IDF features into logistic regression
and a linear SVM.

Macro F1: 0.78 for logistic regression, 0.80 for the SVM. Confusion matrix
and per class scores are plotted in the notebook.

repos.description: Streamlit dashboard for internal marks analysis
repos.readme:
# Marks dashboard

Built this for our class representative. Upload the internal marks sheet
and it produces subject wise distributions, a pass percentage summary and
a per student trend line.

Data visualisation with plotly for the interactive charts and matplotlib
for the static report export.

repos.description: Fruit image classifier with classical computer vision features
repos.readme:
# Fruit classifier

Computer vision assignment. Colour histogram plus HOG features into an SVM,
no neural network here. OpenCV does the preprocessing: resize, blur, HSV
conversion, contour based background removal.

Accuracy 0.88 on a 6 class dataset of 1800 images.

response in a local JSON file so repeated calls in a minute do not hit the
network.
